# Asia-Pacific Journal of Financial Studies

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** AJFS
- **Publisher:** Wiley, for the Korean Securities Association
- **ISSN:** 2041-6156 (portal.issn.org URL; print UNVERIFIED)
- **Homepage:** https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/20416156
- **Author guidelines:** https://apjfs.org/homepage/custom/instruction

## Scope
Official English-language journal of the Korean Securities Association: empirical and theoretical capital-markets research in investments, capital and security markets, corporate finance and quantitative methods (author instructions); SCImago adds market microstructure. Aims to support capital-market development in the Asia-Pacific region.

## Scope Keywords
Asia-Pacific capital markets, investments, security markets, quantitative methods, market microstructure

## Article Types Accepted
- Research article — others UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.542; Finance Q2 (Q3 in 2024) (scimagojr.com source id 19700177345)
- **Open Access:** Hybrid (Wiley OnlineOpen optional). KSA guidelines state a submission fee of KRW 100,000 (≈USD 100) members / KRW 150,000 (≈USD 150) non-members and no publication fee — page appears dated, so current fee UNVERIFIED. Total cost < USD 1,000 on the non-OA route.
- **Field:** Finance

## Special Notes
Review speed (Wiley page): median 53 days submission to first decision; acceptance rate 29 %. AI policy: Wiley (disclose AI use at submission, tool and purpose; no generative AI for images/data) — taken from a third-party summary, UNVERIFIED on Wiley's page.
